criterion.ceiling_fraction: (MAE_V1-MAE_Vk)/(MAE_V1-MAE_previous_V4); unbounded signed ratio, not clipped. Nonpositive denominator is explicitly flagged as unavailable, never silently replaced.
criterion.attribution: Per target compare recovered fractions V6 versus V5: V6>V5 SOC, V5>V6 OCV, equality tie. Both SOC => SOC, both OCV => OCV; otherwise mixed/inconclusive (user confirmed). If ceiling denominator nonpositive, attribution unavailable.
criterion.global: Static transfer positive iff primary A positive; replica B cannot change global result.
